Dress them in a [OUTFIT_COLOR: navy blue] tailored blazer, use [LIGHTING_STYLE: soft diffused softbox] lighting, a clean blurred office backdrop, and an 85mm portrait lens look.

prompts.title: Fashion Editorial
prompts.prompt: Create a high fashion editorial photo of the person in the photo, keeping their face and identity unchanged. Dress them in avant-garde designer clothing, use [LIGHTING_STYLE: dramatic studio] lighting, a minimalist background, and a strong confident pose.

prompts.title: Product Photography
prompts.prompt: Create a professional product photography shot of the object in the photo, keeping its exact shape, colors and branding. Use a clean seamless background, soft studio lighting, subtle reflections, and sharp focus on every detail.

prompts.title: Cinematic Portrait
prompts.prompt: Create a cinematic portrait of the person in the photo, keeping their face and identity unchanged. Use [LIGHTING_STYLE: dramatic side] lighting, a [MOOD: dark moody] background, a shallow depth of field, and a strong film-like color grade.

prompts.title: Macro Photography
prompts.prompt: Turn the photo into a macro photography shot of its main subject. Use extreme close-up framing, a very shallow depth of field, soft natural lighting, and highly detailed textures.

prompts.title: Wildlife Photography
prompts.prompt: Create a wildlife photography shot of the animal in the photo, keeping its species, markings and colors. Use a telephoto lens look, [LIGHTING_STYLE: golden hour] lighting, a blurred [BACKGROUND: savanna] background, and sharp focus on the eyes.

prompts.title: Paparazzi Candid
prompts.prompt: Create a paparazzi-style candid photo of the person in the photo on a busy city street, keeping their face and identity unchanged. Use a harsh on-camera flash, high contrast, motion blur in the background, and a grainy tabloid aesthetic.

prompts.title: Anime / Manga
prompts.prompt: Turn the person in the photo into an anime-style illustration, keeping their face shape, hairstyle and clothing recognizable. Use cel shading, expressive large eyes, dynamic hair, [COLOR_PALETTE: vibrant] colors, and a [STYLE: Japanese manga] aesthetic.

prompts.title: Digital Painting
prompts.prompt: Repaint the photo as a digital painting, keeping its main subject and composition recognizable. Use visible brushstrokes, rich colors, dramatic lighting, and a [STYLE: fantasy concept art] style.

prompts.title: Flat Design Vector
prompts.prompt: Redraw the subject of the photo as a flat design vector illustration, keeping its shape and main colors recognizable. Use simple geometric shapes, solid colors, no gradients, and a clean minimalist composition.

prompts.title: Comic Book
prompts.prompt: Turn the person in the photo into a comic book character, keeping their face, hairstyle and clothing recognizable. Use bold black outlines, halftone dot shading, vivid primary colors, and a dynamic action pose.

prompts.title: Line Art Minimalist
prompts.prompt: Redraw the person in the photo as a minimalist line art illustration, keeping their face and features recognizable. Use clean single-weight black lines, a white background, and no shading or color.

prompts.title: Concept Art
prompts.prompt: Turn the subject of the photo into a professional concept art piece, keeping its features and silhouette recognizable. Use a cinematic composition, dramatic lighting, rich environmental details, and a digital painting style.

prompts.title: Cyanotype / Blueprint
prompts.prompt: Redraw the object in the photo as a cyanotype blueprint, keeping its exact shape and proportions. Use white line drawings on a deep blue background, technical annotations, and a vintage engineering aesthetic.

prompts.title: Renaissance Oil Portrait
prompts.prompt: Paint the person in the photo as a Renaissance-style oil portrait, keeping their face and features recognizable. Use chiaroscuro lighting, rich earthy tones, visible brushwork, and a dark classical background.

prompts.title: Baroque Painting
prompts.prompt: Repaint the photo as a Baroque-style painting, keeping its main subject and composition recognizable. Use dramatic light and shadow, rich [COLOR_PALETTE: gold and red] tones, a dynamic composition, and ornate details.

prompts.title: Pop Art
prompts.prompt: Turn the person in the photo into a Warhol-inspired Pop Art portrait, keeping their face recognizable. Use bold flat colors, thick black outlines, halftone dots, and a single bright solid-color background.

prompts.title: Art Nouveau
prompts.prompt: Turn the person in the photo into an Art Nouveau illustration, keeping their face and features recognizable. Use flowing organic lines, floral ornaments, muted [COLOR_PALETTE: gold and green] tones, and a decorative poster composition.

prompts.title: Cubism
prompts.prompt: Turn the photo into a Cubist painting of the person in it. Apply fragmented geometric shapes, multiple perspectives and muted Picasso-inspired colors to the background and clothing, while their face stays readable and in natural proportions.

prompts.title: Graffiti Mural
prompts.prompt: Paint the person in the photo as a large graffiti mural on a city wall, keeping their face recognizable. Use bold spray paint colors, dynamic lettering, urban decay textures, and a gritty street atmosphere.

prompts.title: Urban Tag
prompts.prompt: Show the person in the photo spray-painting a graffiti tag on a subway train, keeping their face and identity unchanged. Use bold marker strokes, quick spray paint lines, and a raw street style.

prompts.title: Skate Photography
prompts.prompt: Show the person in the photo riding a skateboard mid-trick, keeping their face and identity unchanged. Use a low angle, motion blur, bright daylight, and an urban skatepark background.

prompts.title: Neon City
prompts.prompt: Place the person in the photo on a neon-lit city street at night, keeping their face and identity unchanged. Use glowing signs, wet reflective pavement, blurred traffic lights, and a [MOOD: cyberpunk] atmosphere.

prompts.title: Solo Portrait
prompts.prompt: Create a professional studio portrait of the person in the photo, keeping their face and identity unchanged. Use [LIGHTING_STYLE: soft diffused] lighting, a [BACKGROUND_STYLE: clean neutral] background, and a sharp focus on the face with a natural expression.

prompts.title: Couple
prompts.prompt: Create a romantic portrait of the couple in the photo, keeping both faces and identities unchanged. Position them close together with [LIGHTING_STYLE: warm golden hour] lighting, a soft blurred background, and a natural intimate pose.

prompts.title: Family
prompts.prompt: Create a warm family portrait of the people in the photo, keeping every face and identity unchanged. Use natural relaxed poses, soft outdoor lighting, a [SETTING: cozy home or park] setting, and genuine smiles.

prompts.title: Group / Team
prompts.prompt: Create a professional group portrait of the people in the photo, keeping every person, their faces and their positions, and adding nobody. Give them coordinated smart outfits, a clean [SETTING: studio or office] background, balanced lighting, and a corporate aesthetic.

prompts.title: Selfie / Lifestyle
prompts.prompt: Create a casual lifestyle selfie of the person in the photo, keeping their face and identity unchanged. Use a handheld selfie angle, natural daylight, a candid expression, and an [BACKGROUND: urban or travel] background.

prompts.title: Wedding
prompts.prompt: Create an elegant wedding portrait of the couple in the photo, keeping both faces and identities unchanged. Dress them in formal wedding attire, use soft natural light, a romantic outdoor setting, and a joyful emotional expression.

prompts.title: Baby / Newborn
prompts.prompt: Create a tender newborn portrait of the baby in the photo, keeping their face unchanged. Use soft [COLOR_PALETTE: pastel] colors, gentle natural light, a cozy blanket, and a peaceful expression.

prompts.title: Elderly Person
prompts.prompt: Create a dignified portrait of the person in the photo, keeping their face and identity unchanged. Use warm natural light, a shallow depth of field, visible skin texture and character, and a gentle wise expression.
